column1: # Geocentric apparent places of the Moon and the Sun from JPL Horizons
# Horizons reported: ephemeris source DE441 for both targets; relativistic
# light bending by the Sun; EOP file eop.261110.p270205
# "with respect to ... the Earth equator of-date and meridian containing the
# Earth equinox of-date (EOP-corrected IAU76/80) ... equinox (RA origin) is
# offset -53 mas from the of-date frame defined by the IAU06/00a P & N
# precession and nutation. delta is the light-time-corrected range (au).

# same) gave the astrometric ICRF RA/Dec: light time only
